label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User input 'param' (derived from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')) flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) at line 22. Although a guard checks the Referer header, an attacker can control the Referer header to satisfy the condition (.partner.example), thereby enabling the redirect with arbitrary user-controlled data. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled 'param', and no sanitization is performed.

evidence.note: User input param extracted and passed to sendRedirect without validation
